story.title: Give foot its own touchpad scroll factor (#9793)
story.text: Give foot its own touchpad scroll factor (#9793) foot only applies scrollback.multiplier to discrete wheel clicks, so precise touchpad scrolling ignores it and crawls at the group's 1.5 factor. Split foot out at 2.0 to match how the other terminals feel. Co-authored-by: Claude Fable 5
story.author: dhh

story.title: v4.0.2
story.text: This is an additional set of security fixes that were validated and examined by the [Omarchy Security team](https://omarchy.org/teams/#security). If you ever find security issues with Omarchy, please follow the responsible disclosure procedure on [omarchy.org/security](https://omarchy.org/security/). 🙏 You can upgrade existing machines with `Update > Omarchy`. story.title: Omarchy Top-Bar Intermittent Mouse Click Failure — Forensic Investigation Report
story.text: ### System details Ryzen 5600x, Nvidia 3060 12gb, with 32 gb of ram ### What's wrong? We investigated this issue earlier and found that the problem is intermittent: the top-bar widgets can remain visible while their mouse clicks stop working. Restarting the Omarchy shell or changing the bar position restores the functionality. I rechecked the status bar and Quickshell implementation more closely, and found another possible cause that seems worth investigating.
